items.title: Burnham says he will challenge Trump when UK interests demand it - BBC reports
items.summary: Investing.com -- British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said he was prepared to challenge U.S. President Donald Trump when necessary to protect the UK’s national interests, according to his first major interview since taking office, conducted by the BBC.

items.title: Iran war widens to Red Sea and Caspian despite pause in US strikes
items.summary: Investing.com -- The Iran war spread towards the Red Sea and Caspian Sea over the weekend, despite the United States pausing its airstrikes after 13 consecutive nights of attacks, Reuters reported.

items.title: BofA warns oil volatility could force c. banks to abandon look-through’ policy
items.summary: Investing.com - Persistent oil price volatility caused by global shipping disruptions and geopolitical friction is threatening to entrench core inflation, creating a tough dilemma for major central banks, according to a report by Bank of America (BofA) Global Research. The Wall Street bank warned that standard monetary policy, which typically "looks through" short-term supply-side commodity shocks, may be inadequate after five years of above-target inflation.
